hypotheses.note: the model is gx's E_0 = R × C with the flat extreme-BTZ metric -2dτdr + dr² + r²dθ², entered through the paper-side developing map D (Causal.E0.btzPaperDev, btzPaperDev_eq_nullToMink); the printed metric makes {r = 0} timelike (recorded finding). No hypothesis is added: every true assertion is a theorem about this model, unconditionally.

hypotheses.paper: ≤_U, ≪_U by future causal / chronological curves in U (defi:causal_Ealpha, l.1336-1339)
hypotheses.note: Causal.E0.CLe / CLt: Causal.CurveOn for the local relation Le (some developments causally related in Causal.minkowski 2: Causal.E0.le_iff_btzPaperDev), as gx reads DEC-33

hypotheses.paper: the singular line is lightlike: locally causal, not locally chronal (l.1345)
hypotheses.note: every segment of the axis inside an open W is a future causal curve of W (axis_causalCurveOn); no non-degenerate segment is a chronal curve of any open set (not_chronalCurveOn_axisLine); nothing is ≪_U below a BTZ point (not_lt_of_mem_axis)
I^-_U(p) = ∅ in every open U (stronger than printed); J^- read globally (U = E_0)

hypotheses.paper: a BTZ point is strongly tarentin in the future but not in the past (l.1348-1349)
an E_{≥0}-manifold with at least one extreme BTZ white hole is not past distinguishing (l.1349-1350)
hypotheses.note: past distinguishing read as I^-(x) = I^-(y) ⇒ x = y (Causal.Causality.PastDistinguishing, ETT never defines it); proved for E_0 itself (a manifold with a BTZ line) and abstractly for any causality with SingularFlatAxioms and sing_0 ≠ ∅ (white hole read as BTZ point); the abstract form has no inhabitant with a BTZ point in lean-causal yet (SingularFlatAxioms with sing_0 ≠ ∅ has no witness in the library; the E_0 instance comes with T-ett-port-e0-sfa, gx has it through GX.E0.singularFlatAxioms_of_pushUp and GX.E0LM.e0_pushUp), so until then the evidence is the model case Causal.E0.not_pastDistinguishing
false at every BTZ point of E_0 (Iplus_ne_Jplus_diff, not_btzIplusAsPrinted); strongest true form I^+(p) = Int(J^+(p)) \ sing_0 (Iplus_axis_eq_interior_diff); DEC-64's Iplus_of_lt holds (btzAxioms)

findings: ETT.tex:1353-1355 (flagged at l.1352 '[editorial] quoted from \cite{thesis}, where it is asserted without proof -- verify'): DEC-64's finding, already in the row's ledger paper_findings (f84b69e, 'by hand, not formalized'), and witnessed in gx (GX.E0.Iplus_ne_Jplus_diff at c48aa45): I^+(p) = reg(J^+(p)) = J^+(p) \ sing_0 is false at every BTZ point of E_0. NEW here: (i) the witness inside the ETT library, Causal.E0.Iplus_ne_Jplus_diff and Causal.E0.not_btzIplusAsPrinted (the printed form kept as the Prop Causal.Causality.BTZIplusAsPrinted, kb/0022); (ii) the exact repair at the BTZ model, I^+(p) = Int(J^+(p)) \ sing_0 with Int J^+(p) = {f > τ_p} (Causal.E0.Iplus_axis_eq_interior_diff, interior_Jplus_axis). Which half fails: the inclusion 'J^+(p) \ sing_0 is contained in I^+(p)' (every non-BTZ point of the causal future of p lies in its chronological future) is FALSE — the point (τ_p + 1/2, r = 1) of the radial null ray has f = τ − r/2 = τ_p, so it lies in J^+(p) \ sing_0 = {f ≥ τ_p, r > 0} but not in I^+(p) = {r > 0, f > τ_p}; the inclusion 'I^+(p) is contained in J^+(p) \ sing_0' is TRUE (Causal.E0.Iplus_axis_subset_diff). The refutation does not depend on the metric reading: under the printed metric (l.1330, Minkowski 3-space in cylindrical coordinates) J^+(p) \ {r = 0} also contains the null cone of p, which is not in I^+(p). The repair is specific to the BTZ model: in Minkowski 3-space Int(J^+(p)) \ {r = 0} drops the points of the timelike line above p, which are in I^+(p). DEC-64's form (p < p' on the line ⇒ J^+(p') \ sing_0 ⊆ I^+(p)) is the field Iplus_of_lt of Causal.E0.btzAxioms. A repair of the sentence at the BTZ model: 'every non-BTZ point of the interior of the causal future of p lies in its chronological future'.

ETT.tex:1348-1349: 'In particular a BTZ point is strongly tarentin in the future' does not follow from the displayed facts, which are about the past (I^-(p) = ∅, J^-(p) the half-line). It needs I^+(p) ∩ U ≠ ∅ for every neighbourhood U, i.e. the shape of the future cone of p ({r > 0, f > τ_p}, Causal.E0.Iplus_axis), which the definition only states afterwards (l.1353-1355), and wrongly. The claim itself is true (Causal.E0.mem_Zplus); only 'in particular' overstates the derivation for the future half.

ETT.tex:1330-1331 (already recorded in the curation): the printed metric −dτ² + dr² + r²dθ² makes {r = 0} timelike, not lightlike. The Lean model is the flat extreme-BTZ metric −2dτdr + dr² + r²dθ² of gx (RamcovGX.tex:1944), through the developing map D(τ, r, θ) = (τ + ½rθ², (τ + ½rθ² − r, −rθ)) (Causal.E0.btzPaperDev); with it every causal assertion of the label that is not l.1353-1355 holds.
questions: 'past distinguishing' (l.1350) is not defined in ETT. Reading taken: the usual one, I^-(x) = I^-(y) (global chronological pasts) implies x = y (Causal.Causality.PastDistinguishing). Under it E_0 is not past distinguishing (any two BTZ points have I^- = ∅).

'extreme BTZ white hole' (l.1350) is not defined in ETT. Reading taken: a BTZ point / a component of sing_0 (E_0's BTZ line has empty chronological past, so it is the white-hole orientation); the abstract statement is SingularFlatAxioms with sing_0 ≠ ∅ (Causal.Causality.SingularFlatAxioms.not_pastDistinguishing).

'lightlike: locally causal, but not locally chronal' (l.1345) has no metric to be read against here. Reading taken: every segment of the singular line inside an open set W is a future causal curve of W, and no non-degenerate segment is a chronal curve of any open set (equivalently, no two points of the line are ≪_U-related, since I^-_U(p) = ∅).

Which E_0: the printed metric (l.1330, timelike singular line) or the flat extreme-BTZ metric −2dτdr + dr² + r²dθ² (gx, DEC-64's argument)? Reading taken: the latter, entered through the developing map D; what a 'future causal curve' of E_0 is (defi:causal_Ealpha does not say) is read as gx reads DEC-33: locally, later points have developments in the closed future cone of earlier ones in Minkowski 3-space, the winding being free.

kb_proposals: E_0 is Causal.E0 = ℝ × ℂ (scaffold CausalScaffold.Port.E0Model/E0Causality/E0Axioms, ported verbatim from gx c48aa45): E0.causality is curve-defined, E0.btzAxioms is the BTZAxioms instance at the paper's model E_0 (3-dimensional, BTZ points with non-empty chronological future; the lightlike line, lightlikeLine_btzAxioms, already has a non-empty BTZ locus but I^+ = ∅), and E0.le_iff_btzPaperDev says the local relation is 'some developments are causally related in minkowski 2'. Instantiate BTZ branches there when they need I^+ ≠ ∅ at BTZ points.
